name: outputty
description: A scaffold for developing with Claude Code, copied under ~/.claude/ and into the repo by /outputty:init and owned there: /plan interviews, spikes every level, takes your pick and files one ticket; /tickets picks the next; /build takes it to one PR under a /goal, docs last, or to one stacked PR per layer when you label the ticket stack. The tracker skill is yours, one per machine; GitHub Issues ships as the implementation.

plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: One command, /outputty:init, that copies the scaffold onto the machine and into a repo: the skills plan, prototype, tickets, build, audit, retro, tracker, herdr, documentation, data-engineering, frontend and typescript-node, the code rules and a rule file per language, a ticket template, a PR template, a skill template, a README template, and settings. The plugin itself supplies the standing lines, through a SessionStart hook, and forces its output style. Each copy is edited where it lands; a re-run reports drift per file. A build runs under /goal; review is /code-review.
